section: Oklahoma corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate franchise tax
value: None from tax year 2024: the franchise tax ($1.25 per $1,000 of capital) was repealed
note: Tax year 2023 was the last franchise tax year (HB 1039X). Foreign corporations still pay a registered agent fee.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Other Taxes (Franchise Tax, HB 1039X FAQ)

label: Levied by
value: School districts, counties (general, sinking fund, health department), career-tech districts, junior colleges, emergency medical districts and city sinking funds
note: Schools receive the largest share in every county.
source_title: Oklahoma State Auditor & Inspector: Newsletter November/December 2020, Where Do My Property Taxes Go?

label: State oversight
value: Oklahoma Tax Commission, Ad Valorem Division (with the State Board of Equalization)
note: Values public service property and compiles county abstracts certified by the State Board of Equalization.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Ad Valorem

label: Annual cap on taxable value increases
value: 3% a year for homesteads and agricultural land; 5% for other real property
note: Constitution Art. 10, Sec. 8B; the cap does not apply in a year the property changes hands or for new improvements.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission, Ad Valorem Tax Division: Ad Valorem Statistics 2024

label: Homestead exemption (assessed value)
note: $1,000 of assessed (not market) value; an additional $1,000 applies for qualifying lower-income heads of household (68 O.S. 2889, 2890).
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission, Ad Valorem Tax Division: Ad Valorem Statistics 2024 (statute appendix)

label: Documentary stamp tax on deeds
value: $0.75 per $500 of consideration (or fraction), when consideration exceeds $100
note: Equivalent to 0.15%. Applies to deeds conveying realty that is sold; stamps are sold by the county clerk.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Documentary Stamp Tax Quick Reference Guide (2021), quoting 68 O.S. 3201

label: Who pays
value: Either the buyer (grantee) or the seller (grantor)
note: The rule does not assign it to one party; it is usually settled in the sale contract.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Documentary Stamp Tax Quick Reference Guide (2021), quoting OAC 710:30-1-8

label: County share
value: Counties keep 30.33% of documentary stamp receipts; the rest goes to the Oklahoma Tax Commission
note: From the county clerk's monthly return form.
source_title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Form DS-1, Monthly County Return of Documentary Stamp Sales (revised 11-2021)
